# Transaction Overlap Analysis

> Completed sequential, memory-safe scans. Only aggregate date/month counts are reported; no customer identifiers or raw transaction records are included.

| --- | ---: | ---: |
| transactions.csv | 21,547,746 | 790 |
| transactions_v2.csv | 1,431,009 | 820 |

## transactions_v2.csv period breakdown

| Period | Rows | Percentage of v2 rows |

| Historical overlap period (<= 20170228) | 361,187 | 25.24% |
| March 2017 (20170301 to 20170331) | 1,069,822 | 74.76% |
| Other dates | 0 | 0.00% |

## Conclusions (date-level counts only)

- transactions_v2.csv contains 361,187 historical-dated rows (<= 20170228) and 1,069,822 rows dated in March 2017.
- 789 transaction dates are present in both files.
- Shared dates do not establish duplicate transactions. Exact row duplication and customer/date duplication have not been tested.
